source: Shipped location art (CardImageWarpData of the village academy interior cards), already an empty room, used as it is.
description: the village Academy workshop: sturdy timber-framed walls, heavy wooden workbenches with vises and planes, saws, chisels and pliers hung on a tool rack, coils of rope on pegs, shelves of stacked planks, metal ingots and jars, a small stone forge glowing at the back, a hanging lantern, a slanted drafting lectern with a blueprint, a quill and an inkwell, wide warm-lit floorboards
notes: The plate is framed by a stone archway; a composition may bring the camera inside and drop the arch. Shared by every character's Academy portrait.
